outline: 本課程為大學部的巨量資料分析導論基礎課程，主要介紹資料前處理、資料探勘概念、關聯分析、分類、分群、平行化程式設計、分散式計算、以及實際分析平台工具如: MapReduce, Spark等。除了基本概念的介紹外，透過程式練習以及期末專題，能讓學生深入理解巨量資料分析的基本原理以及實際工具的運用。
schedule:
Part I: Data mining concepts (8 wks)
1. Introduction to big data & preprocessing (1 wk)
2. Frequent pattern mining (2 wks)
3. Data classification (2 wks)
4. Data clustering (2 wks)
5. Midterm exam (1 wk)

Part II: Distributed platforms & Parallel programming (4 wks)
1. Introduction to distributed platforms: Hadoop & Spark  (1 wk)
2. Parallel programming paradigm & concepts (1 wk)
3. MapReduce programming: pairs & stripes, relational algebra (1 wk)
4. More examples: matrix multiplication, similarity (1 wk)

Term project presentation (4 wks)

Flexible Learning: (2 wks)
1. Group-based project implementation and discussions:
for make-up homeworks, and extra bonus

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)

如果有額外完成程式作業，必須於第18週結束前繳交完成。
